calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Nostrum care
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the evaluation of GrowthBook as a tool for A/B testing and traffic management for a React-based web app. Daniel is preparing to test four variants by the month's end, needing traffic splitting and tracking features. The current tool, PostHog, has been found too technical by some users. James highlighted GrowthBook's capabilities, including multi-arm bandit experiments and easy integrations with data warehouses like BigQuery. Additionally, the meeting addressed the necessity of a user-friendly interface for reporting and metrics, ensuring compliance with GDPR, and the potential to start with a free tier to evaluate GrowthBook's fit. The team discussed support materials for onboarding and considered the broader implications of adopting GrowthBook across other teams.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, product analytics, traffic splitting, data warehouse integration, React SDK, GDPR compliance
calls.action_items:
**Daniel Paul Emmanuel-Undie**
Explore the GrowthBook free tier and set up an account to test the platform with his team (34:43)
Discuss GrowthBook’s potential and demo results internally to convince the team for adoption over Posthog (34:43)
Evaluate scalability of GrowthBook for sister companies and future expanded user base (30:15)

**James Shannon**
Send Daniel a sales deck and an implementation guide for GrowthBook to support internal evaluation (35:24)
Provide documentation links and highlight AI chatbot support on the GrowthBook website (36:24)
